settings.name: Senseless Rewards
settings.description: How Senseless Rewards works — earn 1 point per £1 in the app or on the website, redeem 100 points for £1 off, with double points and a welcome bonus in the app.

settings.headline: Earn points every time you shop.
settings.subhead: Collect points on every order — in the app or on the website — and turn them into money off. It's automatic once you have an account; you just need to be signed in.

settings.title: Sign in
settings.text: Create an account or sign in — in the app or on the website. There's no separate sign-up; points start collecting straight away.

settings.title: Spend and earn
settings.text: Earn 1 point for every £1 you spend. Points land on any order placed while you're signed in.

settings.title: Redeem
settings.text: Turn points into money off your next order — 100 points = £1 off, applied from your account.

settings.detail: On every order — in the app or on the website.

settings.headline: Spend, earn, redeem.
settings.intro: Points are tied to your account and collect automatically whenever you're signed in — no cards, no codes.
settings.compare_note: Same account, same points — the app just earns faster. Points marked “coming soon” aren't active yet; they'll start earning once they're live.
settings.terms: Points have no cash value and can't be exchanged for cash. Points earned on an order are removed if that order is later refunded. App-only perks — double points, the 200-point welcome bonus, and birthday points — require the Senseless app. Ways to earn marked “coming soon” are planned and not yet active. This is version 1 of the programme and its terms may change. See the full Rewards Terms & Conditions.

settings.question: Do my points expire?
settings.answer: No. In this first version of the programme, your points don't expire.

settings.question: What happens to my points if I return an order?
settings.answer: Points earned on an order are removed if that order is refunded, in line with the refund.

settings.question: Does guest checkout earn points?
settings.answer: No — points are tied to your account, so you need to be signed in (in the app or on the web). Guest checkout doesn't collect points.

settings.question: How do I redeem points?
settings.answer: Your balance and redeem option are on your account page. 100 points = £1 off — sign in to view and redeem.

settings.question: Where do I see my balance?
settings.answer: Your live balance lives on your account page — sign in to view it. This page is just the overview.

settings.question: Are more ways to earn coming?
settings.answer: Yes — referrals, product reviews and following us on social are on the way. They're marked “coming soon” on this page and will start earning once they're live.

settings.heading: Points start the moment you sign in.
settings.body: Create an account or sign in, then shop as usual — in the app or on the web. Your balance and redeem option live on your account page.
settings.cta_label: Sign in or create an account
